videos.title: THE PROMPTER

videos.title: Critterz — Remastered with Sora
videos.highlight: Seed of OpenAI's AI-animated feature (delayed from Cannes 2026)
videos.description: Shot-for-shot Sora remake of the award-winning animated short, side by side with the original. It is the seed of 'Critterz', the OpenAI-backed feature (budget under $30M, nine-month production) written by the Paddington in Peru writers, which was set to debut at Cannes 2026 and has since been delayed.

videos.title: Fruit Love Island — Episodes 1-9
videos.highlight: AI micro-drama phenomenon · 3.1M followers in 9 days
videos.description: A reality-show parody starring anthropomorphic fruit, released on TikTok by @ai.cinema021 on March 13, 2026. It gained over 3.1 million followers in nine days, with single episodes above 10 million views, and spawned a whole genre of AI fruit micro-dramas. Originally on TikTok; this is a YouTube compilation.

videos.title: Tom Cruise vs. Brad Pitt — the Seedance 2.0 clip that shook Hollywood
videos.director: Ruairí Robinson (clip) · report by Inside Edition
videos.highlight: The most viral AI clip of 2026 · 3M+ views on X
videos.description: A 15-second rooftop fistfight between AI versions of Tom Cruise and Brad Pitt, made by Irish filmmaker Ruairí Robinson with a two-line Seedance 2.0 prompt. It triggered statements from SAG-AFTRA and the MPA and a cease-and-desist from Disney. Some argue it was green screen plus face swap. The original was posted on X; this is a news report that shows the clip.

videos.title: Pomegranate — Sci-Fi Short Film
videos.highlight: Preview of the feature 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' · in US theaters Oct 30
videos.description: After centuries of simulated wars, wives and wonders, a jaded aristocrat visits his neighborhood dreamspool dealer looking for something that still feels real. Written and directed by Zack London. Produced by Gossip Goblin + Fable Studio (Edward Saatchi). Animation lead: Alexandru Mihai. Models: TBD. This version, uploaded by Twistborn Stories, has English and Chinese subtitles. Pomegranate is the preview short of Zack London's first feature, 'Gods Don't Give Gifts': a sci-fi horror anthology of four shorts set in the 'Second Cycle of Humanity', opening in several hundred US theaters on October 30, 2026 (no trailer yet).

videos.title: LEGO — Everyone Wants a Piece (World Cup 2026)
videos.highlight: The counterpoint: NO AI · 314M views in 24h
videos.description: Mbappé, Messi, Ronaldo and Vini Jr. all want a piece of the LEGO FIFA World Cup trophy, and they are not alone. Posted with #HonestlyItsnotai: traditional effects and body doubles, no generative AI. 314 million views on players' Instagram accounts in 24 hours. Included as a contrast: the idea beats the tool.
